title: Reset Password: Let Users Recover Their Accounts | Orchard Core
description:
A user who forgets a password has to ask an administrator to change it.

The Users Reset Password feature adds a Forgot your password? link to the login page. The site emails the user a link, and the link opens a form for choosing a new password. An administrator enables the feature, provides an email provider, and allows the reset in the settings.

In this video:
• How password recovery works and what the site needs
• Enabling the feature and checking the email settings
• Allowing password reset in the settings
• A user asking for a reset link
• The email the user receives
• Choosing a new password and logging in
• Limits, delivery problems and verified email addresses
